task.sentence: The ruins in which they were trapped were dangerous.
task.prompt: which 指向前面的哪个词？

hints: 问题出在 which 的指向，再找一次。
先找 which 前面的名词。
which 在这里回指一个先行词。
先行词是被后面从句补充说明的名词。
完整结构：which 回指 the ruins；in which = in the ruins。

variants.sentence: The house in which we stayed was quiet.
The city in which she was born has changed greatly.
The room in which the meeting was held is upstairs.
